title: Giraffe waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0a020'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#f2c94c'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='82' r='3' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='74' r='3.5' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='85' r='2.5' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='86' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <rect x='40' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <rect x='53' y='86' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <rect x='62' y='88' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='27' y='95' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <rect x='40' y='95' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <rect x='53' y='95' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <rect x='62' y='95' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M58 72 Q66 50 60 30 Q58 22 52 22 Q48 22 48 30 Q52 50 46 72 Z' fill='#f2c94c'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='62' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='48' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='35' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#c98a1c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='19' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f2c94c'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='43' y='7' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <rect x='53' y='7' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='7' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='7' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe29a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='16' r='2' fill='#4a3010'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='16' r='2' fill='#4a3010'/>
  <circle cx='45.7' cy='15.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='55.7' cy='15.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='15' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='15' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b83c'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M66 74 Q78 66 80 54' stroke='#e8b83c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand (hoof) -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#8a5a10'/>
  <!-- motion lines near hand -->
  <path d='M86 46 Q89 49 88 53' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M85 56 Q88 58 90 56' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 74 Q14 72 14 66' stroke='#e8b83c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='65' r='3' fill='#8a5a10'/>
</svg>
